There was no family history of neuromuscular disease or history of systemic illness, vigorous physical activity or concomitant intake of other drugs. Neurological examination showed normal mental status and cranial nerves. On the up-right position, the neck was slightly flexed and drawn down into the shoulder girdle, the arms flexed 308at the elbow, the lumbar curve exaggerated (hyperlordosis) and the hips as well as knees flexed 30 8. The patient's volitional activity was significantly reduced and he moved with great difficulty, like a 'wooden soldier' or a 'robot'. There was marked, stable resistance to passive movements throughout the entire range of motion of the neck, shoulders, elbows, hips and knees.
